_comment: Project Architect 2.0 — settings merge snippet. NOT a drop-in settings file. Two sections: 'global' merges into ~/.claude/settings.json, 'project' merges into <repo>/.claude/settings.json. Merge rules (SETUP.md is the authority): add a key ONLY if absent; never overwrite an existing key; NEVER touch 'model'. Back up the target file first (timestamped .bak), then JSON-validate the result.
_comment_global: statusLine: the command assumes bash on PATH and the script at ~/.claude/statusline.sh (SETUP.md copies it there). On Windows-native Claude Code, replace 'bash' with the full path to git-bash's bash.exe. effortLevel 'xhigh' is the persistent baseline per the effort doctrine (Max/Ultracode are session-only). The permissions allowlist covers read-only git so session-start preflight never prompts.
_comment_project: SessionEnd hook: backs up the session transcript (and sweeps stragglers) into <repo>/.claude-state/ via the shipped script — rule H8's per-session leg. The command is repo-relative; hooks run from the project directory. Timeout keeps a slow disk from hanging session exit.
_comment_project_local: NOT in this snippet (machine-local, absolute path required): .claude/settings.local.json gets { "autoMemoryDirectory": "<abs-repo-path>/.claude-state/memory" } — SETUP.md resolves and writes it at install; a fresh machine re-runs that one step (see ops-setup).
